sentences.text: City parks were once seen as simple green spaces.
Today planners treat them as part of public health.
A walk among trees lowers stress for many people.
Doctors in some cities now suggest park visits to patients.
Parks also cool neighbourhoods on hot summer days.
Shade from large trees can reduce street temperatures.
Keeping parks safe and clean costs money every year.
Some towns ask volunteers to help with the work.
Planners say small parks close to homes matter most.
People visit them more often than large distant ones.
